title: Interphase hand-off: amendment 2 (voice-peaks S1) handed off after two reviews, build it on mitosis/voice-peaks
context: Amendment 2 adds criterion 16.39 and Step macos-decoder-rate-guard (MSP voice-peaks-amend-2). The first spec review found one Missing class: the guard refused only NaN and 0, but a finite rate whose rounded 100 ms window reaches 2^63 frames (9.3e19 Hz and up, fact f-int-bound) also traps Int(). Refusal of such files by AVAudioFile was shown only for CAF on macOS 26.5.1, while the app supports macOS 12. The settlement changed several things. Rate classes are now set by value: valid finite, NaN, 0 or below, positive infinity, and too large. A separate opens domain covers whether AVAudioFile opens the file. A new windowFrames function is required. A third test lifts that function alone and checks NaN, 0, -16000, both infinities, 9.3e19, 1e-300, 4, 16000 and 9.2e19 without opening any file. The follow-up review approved with no issues. Both guards (checkout and voice-peaks tree) verified clean, and check_record --complete passed with status handed-off. The plan-only run (plan fb1d832f708e) gave exit 0 with one cheap Lane.
options: Build amendment 2 now with amend-2.zsh on mitosis/voice-peaks, merge it into voice-peaks, then review voice-peaks round 2
Keep the narrower NaN-and-0 guard from the first draft
Fold amendment 3 (windows-reminder-guard) into the same build
option_reasons: The spec is handed off with an approving review and a clean plan; amendments build one after another.
The first review showed it leaves 9.3e19 Hz and up able to quit the app on every launch, the failure S1 exists to remove.
Each amendment has its own MSP, write-set and round accounting, and the pipeline runs them one after another.
outcome: Handed off. Build amend-2.zsh (--no-push, run dir recorder-comets-and-fixes-amend-2), merge mitosis/voice-peaks-amend-2 into mitosis/voice-peaks in its worktree, then run voice-peaks review round 2 (previous head dc79601b, earlier findings round-1/voice-peaks.md, base mitosis/recorder). Meanwhile, amendment 3 (windows-reminder-guard C1) goes through interphase on the same record.
